items.title: The degree of a splitting field is divisible by the degree of the skew field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file brauer.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a finite central skew field of degree d, every finite splitting field has degree over the ground field divisible by d (statement lines 906-911). The proof is a complete argument: the characterization of splitting fields produces an algebra in the same Brauer class whose degree is the square of the degree of the splitting field (proof lines 913-916), and by similarity that algebra is a matrix algebra over the skew field, so its degree is the size of the matrix times the degree of the skew field; comparing and taking square roots gives the divisibility (proof lines 917-919). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two degree computations. The claim is H2.
